title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Query on old Zakaat Calculation 2028 views Q. My mother-in-law is a widow and she is earning Rs.13,000 every month from her pension, her husband's half pension and also through rent.Whenever she has to pay zakat she will cry that she has to give so much and now she says some one has said to her that as now she is widow now she can ask her sons to pay zakat. Is it correct that her son can pay zakat? As she doesn't spend a single amount on her sons. 5784 views Q. I have gold worth of 4 lakh 50 thousand and I have fixed deposit of 2 lakh 50 thousand (on fixed deposit one year has not been completed) and also I have bank loan on 4,70,000/-. Please tell me how much zakah I should pay in this Ramadan? 2641 views Q. Assalamualaikum, This is regarding the zakat on Provident Fund(PF). I would like to know if zakat is valid on Provident Fund(PF). I am still working with the company and I haven't got it till now. I will get the Provident Fund(PF) once I leave the comapny. But there is a way by which I can check how much Provident Fund(PF) is contributed till date. Would like to know if I have to pay the zakat on PF , though the amount is not with me. Please reply ASAP. Assalamualaikum 2659 views Q. Can zakat be paid to Masjid Imam 6864 views Q. Can I give my zakah to my brother who is a university student? I am a Govt. employee and I want to give my zakah to my brother 2081 views Q. Zaakat is pending for around 30 years for Jwellery of my mother. Now we want to pay Zaakat now. Please let us know whether we have to pay zaakt of jwellery ,which is of gold and silver, of current price or we can calculate zaakat on the basis of old prices of gold and silver? 1857 views Q. If a person belonging to syed family wants to give his zakat to his relative who is also a syed. I think zakat should not be given to a syed family person. Hence, he has decided to give his zakat to a non-syed person and get back the zakat amount from him as gift. Then he handed over the gift amount to his syed relative. Is it correct procedure. pl. clarify. 3581 views Q. ASalamulika, Dear Molavi Sahib,I love to ask my question in Urdu, but unfortunetaly I don't speak Urdu, the question is, for example Ahmad is the son of Mahmmod, Mahmmod is very rich person, and Ahmad is also living with Mahmmod, but does not have any authorization in his father Affluence, his father Mahmmod feed his son, but does not take care of Ahmad's Children excpet for food and housing, though Ahmad also needs money for his children and wife expenses. now can we give Zakat to Ahmad? is his father's money his? I hope you understand my question. and your quick reply will be highly appreciated. Wasalam! 1626 views Q. Am I doing right or doing biddah 1432 views Q. I am living in Dubai. Can I give Zakathul Fitr in Sri Lanka. 1681 views Q. ZAKAAT TO SAYED relative(Mammu) 1609 views Q. We are staying in a Rented House. 1. We have one own house which has been given for lease for three years which we wont get any rent for the next three years. We bought another house with the intention of staying there. Now we want to sell that and buy a new one for our staying. Is zakak is applicable on the houses? 2. I am having Mutual Funds of about 150000. I am paying loan of 200000 every year. I dont have any cash in my hand. Do I need to pay zakat for Mutual Funds? 3461 views Q. Zakaat on property purchased without any firm intention. 2580 views Q. mufti sab assalamalaikum..we own commercial buildings and get a monthly rent of about rs 7 lacs pm..since the land and building is given out for rent only and not sale..i would like to know if i have to pay zakat on the rent recieved by me..specially when the entire rent is being consumed by me and my family and not saved for one whole year ..thank you .. 2376 views
answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 13608 Country: BH Title: Salam Alaykum,I have intrest amount, What to do for that money? Question: Salam Alaykum,I have intrest amount, What to do for that money? Answer ID: 13608 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1073/908=D/1430) Give it in charity to the poor without an intention of reward. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
